text: On 23 January 2023, Jolene told Deborah that she had finished an electrical engineering project the week before (the week of 16 January 2023), which had taken a lot of work but was now done.
Deborah visited her mother's old house the week before 23 January 2023 (the week of 16 January 2023), a place full of memories; her mother had passed away a few years earlier.
Deborah's mother used to sit every morning on a special bench near the window in her house to take in the view, and Deborah sometimes sits in that same spot to feel connected to her mother.
Jolene's mother passed away in 2022, and Jolene has a room in her mother's house with many memories; she shared a photo of a room with a bench and a window.
Jolene's mother gave her a heart-shaped pendant with a bird on it in 2010 in Paris, and the pendant reminds Jolene of her mother.
Jolene's jewelry has a special symbol that represents freedom for her, serving as a reminder to go for her goals and not get held back.
Deborah also owns a pendant that reminds her of her mother.
One of Deborah's goals is to keep teaching yoga and supporting her community, with a passion for helping people find peace and joy through yoga.
Deborah became passionate about yoga because it helped her find peace during a rough time, and she now wants to share that peace with others.

Deborah's dad passed away suddenly two days before 27 January 2023, which is 25 January 2023, leaving her and her family shell-shocked; she was trying to channel her grief by spending more time with family and cherishing memories.
Deborah and her family looked through the family album, including a photo of her parents' wedding in 1993, and Deborah said that photos give her peace during difficult times.
Deborah and her husband are trying to be as good a family as her parents were, and they have kept their relationship close over the years through love and openness.
On 26 January 2023, Deborah received a letter from her yoga group members thanking her for the positive influence she had on them, which reminded her why she is so passionate about yoga.
Deborah does yoga in her old home, and sitting by the window in that house gives her peace; her mother used to sit there every night reading a book, and reading and travel were her mother's hobbies.
Jolene has two pet snakes, Susie and Seraphim, and Jolene said that they calm her down and make her happy.
Seraphim, one of Jolene's pet snakes, slinked out of her cage and coiled up next to Jolene while Jolene was playing video games, and Jolene said she bought the snake a year earlier in Paris.
In the week of 16 January 2023, Jolene and her partner played the console game 'Detroit' together, and both are crazy about gaming as an activity they share.
Jolene said that even as a child she learned to play video games on her own, without anyone teaching her.
Jolene and her partner planned to play the game 'Walking Dead' next Saturday, relative to the session date of 27 January 2023.
On 1 February 2023, Jolene said her engineering professor had given the class a huge robotics project, which was tough but fun and was making her more creative and better at problem-solving.
When Jolene first received the robotics project she felt excited and nervous, but by 1 February 2023 she was really enjoying it, describing it as solving a puzzle of design and programming.
Deborah met her new neighbour Anna on 31 January 2023 (the day before the session dated 1 February 2023), and they first met at yoga in the park.
Deborah and Anna talked about how yoga has improved their lives and the sense of community it gives them.
When Deborah asked whether Jolene had thought about resuming yoga, Jolene replied that she and her partner had planned to play the console together instead.

In the week of 23 January 2023, Jolene had a major engineering milestone: she planned, researched, designed and built a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need, and she found it very satisfying to see it providing clean water.
Jolene's career aspiration, stated on 4 February 2023, is to keep working in engineering and make a positive impact on communities in need by creating sustainable solutions.

Deborah teaches yoga and bonded with her new neighbour Anna during a yoga class on 3 February 2023, where they tried dance poses including Warrior II, which Deborah described as a pose that builds strength and boosts focus.

Deborah described a modified seated twist: sit on the edge of a chair with feet planted, twist the torso to one side, use one hand on the knee for support, hold for a few breaths, then switch sides, which relaxes tense muscles.
Jolene is really into the book 'Sapiens', which she describes as a fascinating look at human history and how technology has affected us.
Around 21 January 2023, two weeks before 4 February 2023, Jolene read 'Avalanche' by Neal Stephenson in one sitting.
Deborah's favourite nature spots are a park with a forest trail, where she enjoys getting lost in nature, and a nearby beach where the sound of waves and sand make her feel peaceful and happy.
Jolene took a photo of a sunset over the water on a vacation in Bogota in the summer of 2022, and said that the calm of the scene made her appreciate nature's calming power.

Deborah goes to a spot by the water near her mother's old house to reflect on her mother's life, and she brings her mother's amulet with her, which helps her feel her mother's love and stay close to her.
Anna wears a pendant in memory of her own mother, and Deborah said this shared experience brought the two of them closer together.
A friend gave Deborah a bouquet of flowers while she was struggling, and the bouquet gives her hope and courage whenever she looks at it.
Jolene held a mini retreat on the Wednesday before 9 February 2023 to assess where she is in life, and said it was a confidence boost that gave her a new outlook.
During her mini retreat, Jolene came up with new solutions for her engineering project and wants to look into green tech to make a difference in disadvantaged areas.

Jolene proposed a volunteer program in which engineers teach STEM to underprivileged kids, planning workshops with local schools or centres and inviting engineers as guest speakers to show kids career options.
As of 9 February 2023, Jolene had not yet reached out to any schools or centres about the STEM volunteer program, because she wanted to solidify the plan first.
Jolene shared photos of her sketches and notes for the STEM volunteer program in her planner on 9 February 2023.
On the night of 21 February 2023, Jolene had a great night out with her friends, with dinner and drinks, and said she was glad to let her hair down.
Deborah lost a friend in the week of 13 February 2023 and has been spending time in her garden, which has roses and dahlias that bring her peace, to find comfort.
Deborah shared the last photo she has with her friend Karlie, taken the summer before 22 February 2023 when they hiked together, and said every time she sees it she smiles.
Deborah travelled to Bali in 2022, which she called one of her favourite trips because it gave her peace and was a gorgeous island great for yoga.
Jolene said on 22 February 2023 that she wants to try yoga on the beach after Deborah described the sound of the waves and the fresh air, and said she would keep Deborah posted.

As of 25 February 2023, Jolene was balancing engineering school with her partner's video games and was setting aside time for herself to do yoga and meditation, which helps her stay calm amid the craziness.
Jolene said yoga helps her chill out and gain perspective, and that afterward she feels more alert and motivated; when overwhelmed she takes a break to do breathing or meditate.
Jolene's partner has started joining her yoga sometimes, which has brought them closer, and they have been together for three years without being married yet.
Jolene said the ring on her partner's hand is just a decoration and not a wedding ring, as of 25 February 2023.
Jolene and her partner met in an engineering class in college, quickly became friends, and the friendship later developed into a romantic relationship.
Jolene and her partner enjoy teaming up on engineering projects together, and Jolene said they understand each other's struggles and both love the work.

Deborah's daily routine as of 25 February 2023 is to meditate, do yoga and teach classes in the morning, and spend evenings with loved ones; on 24 February 2023 she went for her first morning jog in a nearby park and plans to keep jogging.
Deborah said that exercise is key for her because it makes her feel connected to her body, and she quoted the saying that you cannot pour from an empty cup.
Deborah said that Anna got her a vegan stir-fry of tofu and vegetables with ginger and soy sauce the other day (late February 2023), and it was really tasty.
Jolene said one of her favourite dishes is lasagna, and that comfort food is a great pick-me-up while she has a lot going on with her studies and exams.
Jolene did yoga and meditation to relax on Friday 24 February 2023, and Deborah said she also took time for herself to reset her mind around the same time.
On Sunday 26 February 2023, Jolene took her pet snake Seraphim to the park, where she loved exploring new places, and Jolene said people are surprised when they see a tamed snake.
As of 2 March 2023, Jolene said she needs to be more mindful of her stress levels and mental health, because she gets too caught up in her studies and forgets to prioritise self-care.
Deborah advised Jolene to break study work into smaller pieces, set goals for herself, and use planners or schedulers for time management so that she has time for herself.
Deborah promised to give Jolene a yellow coffee mug with a handwritten encouraging message to help her through her exams, and Jolene said it cheered her up.
Deborah started teaching a yoga class in her neighbourhood and hosted a class for her neighbours on Friday 10 March 2023, after which she said it was great to see everyone enjoy it.
Deborah teaches yoga because she finds it calming and wants to share that peace and awareness with others, and she has made great friends through teaching and building community connections.
On 13 March 2023, Jolene said she was having a hard time dealing with her engineering assignments, which were a lot to manage, and asked to talk with Deborah about time management.
On 13 March 2023, Jolene said she would check her schedule and get back to Deborah to find a time to chat about time management.
As of 22 March 2023, Jolene uses the Pomodoro Technique of 25 minutes of work followed by a 5-minute break to avoid burnout, but she still struggles to prioritise her tasks.
Jolene said that making a to-do list for her many tasks feels overwhelming, and she shared a photo of a notepad from her to-do list made last Friday (17 March 2023).
Deborah explained the Eisenhower Matrix to Jolene as a method that sorts tasks into four boxes based on how urgent and important they are, and she shared a visual breakdown of it.
Jolene said on 22 March 2023 that she would give the Eisenhower Matrix a try to see whether it helps her stay focused and less stressed.
Jolene wants to learn to surf and has been gathering information, watching videos and getting a beginners' guide to surfing, but she still needs to find the right time and place to get a lesson.
Deborah and Anna recently sat by the sea watching the sunset and realised that they inspire each other, as of 22 March 2023.
On Friday 24 March 2023, Jolene had a breakthrough on her engineering project and finally found a solution to a problem that had been bugging her for a while.

Deborah bought new props for her yoga class and a candle with a sprig of rosemary to create atmosphere and improve her yoga practice, and she said she is a big fan of candles and essential oils that add warmth and calm.
Jolene feels relaxed during yoga and loves creating a serene space with soothing scents such as lavender and rosemary, as stated on 28 March 2023.
Jolene listens to Nils Frahm and Olafur Arnalds during her yoga practice, and Deborah recommended the track 'Savana' and the album 'Sleep', which she listens to for meditation and deep relaxation.
In the week of 3 April 2023, Deborah went biking nearby with her neighbour, and on 9 April 2023 she checked out an art show with a friend, which reminded her of her mom.

Deborah's mom was interested in art and believed that art could convey strong emotions and connect people uniquely, and going to art shows feels like experiencing it together with her even though she has passed away.

Jolene said her snakes cannot understand what she is going through, but their time together teaches her to take time and be in tune with herself, and playing video games with her partner after a long day is a great way for her to relax.
As of 9 April 2023, Jolene had been working on a big project that was tough but cool to watch take shape, and she said these activities bring her and her partner closer together.
In May 2023, Jolene wrapped up her tough engineering project, a solar-powered vehicle, and on 6 June 2023 she shared a photo of the finished result and said she was proud of sticking with it.

As of 6 June 2023, Jolene is interning at a well-known engineering firm, which she says is a great opportunity to test her skills and gain real-world experience, and the best part is applying what she learned in school to real projects.

Jolene said her internship has had a positive impact on her life, stoking her love of engineering and encouraging her to keep striving for her dreams, and being around people who love what they do has kept her focused.
Jolene finds work-life balance hard during her internship and has found it difficult to make time for her hobbies and chilling out, as of 6 June 2023.
On the morning of 5 June 2023, Jolene did yoga on top of Mount Talkeetna as a way to unwind, and she has been doing yoga and meditation sporadically for about three years.
Jolene said yoga and meditation have helped her with stress and kept her centred, and she does not know how she would have survived without them.
Deborah advised Jolene to practise mindful breathing by setting aside a few minutes each day to sit with eyes closed, take deep breaths, and focus on how the air feels entering and leaving the body.
In late June 2023, Deborah was getting ready for a yoga retreat with some buddies, a chance to be with people who think like her and find peace and understanding.
On 26 June 2023, Deborah said she had tried Dancer Pose (Natarajasana) and shared a photo of herself attempting it on the beach.
Jolene bought a new aquarium for her snake Seraphim on 24 June 2023, the day before yesterday relative to 26 June 2023, and said she got Seraphim the year before, in 2022.

As of 26 June 2023, Jolene said things have been intense because she is really pushing herself to succeed, which sometimes feels overwhelming, but she is determined to overcome obstacles and achieve her goals.
Jolene said she had a big breakthrough with a project in the week of 26 June 2023, which she found exciting and rewarding.
Deborah shared a photo from her retreat of a large statue, which she said is a symbol of peace and enlightenment, and a tree pose she tried with others during the retreat.
On 9 July 2023, Deborah said she had started a running group with her new neighbour Anna, and she said the group pushes and helps each other stay motivated during runs.
Jolene is adding workouts into her studying schedule as of 9 July 2023, which she finds tough but fun.
Jolene and her partner love playing the competitive team-strategy game 'It Takes Two' together, and Jolene said gaming together is a great way for them to bond and get closer.

Deborah goes running and does yoga and meditation with others, and she organises workshops and events on yoga, meditation and self-reflection to cultivate self-awareness and help people find inner peace.
Jolene said she was fascinated by reptiles and that a snake felt like the perfect pet for her, and that taking care of it has been really calming and a great way to connect with nature.
Jolene's snake escaped once during a 'snake adventure'; Jolene spent hours searching and was relieved to find her snuggled under the bed, which showed her how much she loves the snake.
Deborah has cats and does not like dogs, and she takes her cats out for a run in the park every morning and evening because exercise and nature are important to her.
